step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the potentially fraudulent payment is a direct deposit:

ul.li: If yes, terminate the direct deposit by referring to Ending a direct deposit . Go to step 7. Ending a direct deposit

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is an outstanding Action Item (AI) WI for a potential fraud referred to Integrity:
Add the information related to the potentially fraudulent application to the existing Integrity AI WI as follows:

ul.li: Right-click and select Add details/Further Inquiry .
Details : Type “Payment [reference number] issued on [DD-MM-YYYY] for the weeks of [DD-MM-YYYY] to [DD-MM-YYYY] is potentially fraudulent. Request submitted to IPOC to cancel the payment.”

step.cmd: Refer the payment information to Integrity by creating an AI WI as follows:

ul.li:
Destination — Level: At level 4 - National Integrity (ISB) and sub-level 2 - ID Validation, select the processing unit in the region where the client lives:
Atlantic: Processing - ATL
Quebec: Processing - QC
Ontario: Processing - ON
Western Canada and Territories: Processing - WT
End user: Select Next available user.
Details: Type “Payment [reference number] issued on [DD-MM-YYYY] for the weeks of [DD-MM-YYYY] to [DD-MM-YYYY] is potentially fraudulent. Request submitted to IPOC to cancel the payment.”

step.cmd: Determine if a continuing claim has been compromised :
In FTS, determine if an MA71 is imposed:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and impose an MA71 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Leave the field blank.
Manual action: Select 71 - Integrity Services case .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the returned payment issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 14.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li:
Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is active or can be reactivated, select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If the claim is in MPS or if it is blocked dormant , select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is active or can be reactivated, select 24 - Cancelled payment for purge and recreate (P/R) .
If the claim is in MPS or blocked dormant , select 43 - Cancelled payment for MPS .
Remarks line 1: Type “Returned payment — potential fraud. D39 [XXXX]-1 to [XXXX]-5.”

Remarks line 2 to 4: Type “T071-2 (for current year decrease) or T071-8 (for earlier year decrease) — reason F — w/c [XXXX] — CT [XX] — gross amount [XXXX] — federal tax [XX] — provincial tax [XX] — net amount [XXXX] — PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the AI WI for the returned payment issue.
